verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships a built-in AI assistant, AskFred, that answers natural-language questions about one meeting or many and keeps context across follow-ups. The Fred bot can also be invited to meetings to record, transcribe and summarize them. However, the evidence shows mainly Q&A and retrieval, not delegating action-taking tasks to the assistant. The action-capable tools (sharing meetings, creating soundbites) are MCP tools for external AI clients, so they do not count for the built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of AskFred executing tasks or taking actions inside the product, multi-step agentic delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
Maintain conversations where follow-up questions preserve context from previous exchanges
Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.
